title: Sunda Kelapa Lighthouse
scope: Standing Sunda Kelapa Lighthouse, with the original white stone shaft, gallery and historic lantern profile on the original location by Jakarta Fish Port.
limitations: The lantern railing, paint weathering and the masonry entrance orientation are approximations. The 1875 photograph is the visual basis for the upper lantern.
The wharf sheds and modern port buildings are outside the scope.
